title: Effect of homestead declaration and declaration of allodial ownership on property tax liability | Washington State
summary: Washington Attorney General opinion (1996) that allodial-freehold and land-patent declarations do not exempt property from tax and a homestead does not block tax foreclosure.

assertions.quote: a property owner may not avoid the payment of property taxes by claiming to own the property in question as an allodial freehold estate
It was, therefore, of no legal significance, and did not create a defense to a foreclosure action.
the homestead exemption does not bar a foreclosure for unpaid real property taxes

verdicts.note: Homestead protections shield against personal creditors, and most states let counties foreclose for property tax regardless.
